Narrator.style: Warm, gentle bedtime storyteller speaking slowly and clearly.

Fox.style: Curious, friendly young fox voice with bright articulation.

Owl.style: Calm, wise owl mentor voice with soothing evening pacing.

pages.image_prompt: Children's picture book illustration, vertical 9:16, warm moonlight over a cozy forest cabin, a little orange fox holding a glowing paper lantern at the doorstep, soft painterly plush textures, one clear focal action.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.en: Click! The paper lantern glows softly under the silver moon.
lines.zh: 咔哒！小纸灯笼在银色月光下轻轻亮了起来。

lines.speaker: Fox
lines.en: Look, Grandpa Owl! My lantern is ready!
lines.zh: 快看，猫头鹰爷爷！我的灯笼准备好啦！

pages.image_prompt: Medium shot vertical 9:16 storybook frame, the little fox gently swings the glowing lantern while fireflies drift up through mossy pines, warm golden rim light.
pages.motion_prompt: Storybook animation, medium shot, golden fireflies float gently upward around the little fox holding a warm lantern, slow subtle camera push-in. Audio: soft crickets and gentle breeze.

lines.speaker: Owl
lines.en: Hold it steady, little fox. Let us follow the quiet trail.
lines.zh: 拿稳了哦，小狐狸。我们顺着安静的小路走吧。

pages.image_prompt: Cozy storybook wide shot vertical 9:16, the little fox and owl resting on a mossy log looking at starry skies, soft blue-amber twilight palette.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.en: Safe and warm beneath the stars. Goodnight, forest.
lines.zh: 在星空下安心又温暖。晚安，小森林。
